section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion summarizes a single study that tested a theoretical model linking recalled peer warmth/safeness, self-compassion, and social safeness to higher body appreciation and lower disordered eating in a female emerging adult sample. Correlational and path analyses indicated body appreciation was positively associated with recalled peer warmth, self-compassion, and social safeness, negatively associated with BMI and disordered eating, and self-compassion and social safeness mediated the relationship between early peer warmth and body appreciation.
